terrain_tilt_hint: Two fingers tilt the map too. Edit with the map flat when points sit on steep ground.
terrain_automated: Off in automated runs: no terrain tiles are requested.
terrain_off_hint: Relief shades the ground under the map data; 3D raises it and tilts the map. Elevation from Mapterhorn.
terrain_notice_title: Elevation from Mapterhorn: for looking, not for mapping
terrain_notice_text: Mapterhorn combines many elevation sources. Not all of their licences are known to be compatible with OpenStreetMap. Do not derive OSM data from these heights (tracing, contours, ele tags).
